description: AoP task inbox (AGENTS.md rule 13): late instructions reach a running agent; same hook as Claude's .claude/settings.json. Fallback when nothing arrives: python <tasks>/tasks.py inbox <TASK> --unread --reader codex at every step start. The command is plain Python (no shell syntax, any shell): a missing script (Codex started outside the repo root) exits 0 instead of python's exit 2.
